correctness.rationale: Incidence walks of length three give s+t+1 on flags and α on antiflags, yielding A³=cA+aK in characteristic two, where K is the all-ones cross-shore matrix. The row and column sums give AK=KA and A²K=(s+1)(t+1)K. For even α the cases are A³=A (T⁶=I with T²,T³ not identity) and A³=0≠A² (order 8). For odd α and both parameters odd, A³=K≠0=A⁴ gives a zero block of length four and order 8. The other odd-α cases give A⁵=A³ with a nonzero one-primary component; A⁴+A² detects exactly whether any zero block has length three. It is nonzero for mixed parity. For both parameters even, its vanishing is precisely A²=diag(J,J); uniqueness of joins and meets and the nontrivial degrees make this an even-order projective plane. Two distinct point basis vectors sum to a vector in ker A² but not ker A there, and the exchanged constant vectors give a size-two one block, yielding order 12; otherwise the zero block of length three and a one block give order 24. On a size-j adjacency block the wave characteristic polynomial is (X+1)^{2j} or (X²+X+1)^j depending on eigenvalue 0 or 1. The primary-factor kernel dimensions 1 and 2 respectively show there is one cyclic block over F2 in each case. Intersecting with X^k−1 gives the stated minima and factor of two; scalar extension preserves nullities, and Möbius inversion counts labelled primitive orbits. The inverse exists and the state space is finite, so no state has a transient. An independent binary matrix check on the triangle, affine planes of orders two and three, and Fano plane confirmed the four orders and all 96 fixed-space nullities for k=1,…,24 on those samples.
residual_risks: The small replay corroborates but does not prove universality; that comes from the incidence and primary-block argument. No rank classification over all realized geometries or assertion that every divisor is a state period is needed.

value.rationale: The complete order law isolates a recognizable geometric exception to the 24-step behavior, and explains why a non-plane may have a different period from a plane of the same parity. The six small adjacency nullities give every orbit population without enumerating a state space of exponential size. This goes beyond listing a few example periods or transferring a generic reversible recurrence.
residual_risks: The useful census still needs the ranks of the actual realized incidence matrix; it does not reduce all orbit populations to just (s,t,α).
